title: lobostemon regulariflorus

It is traditionally used in South Africa for its medicinal properties, which are said to provide relief from various health issues, including inflammation and pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, which have been found to exhibit therapeutic actions such as analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
